question: Which other large sponsors run NPact's Fund Investment Tool (FIT) on Oracle NetSuite or Blackbaud Financial Edge NXT as their DAF fund-accounting layer, and should the ledger-family taxonomy add a 'NetSuite + NPact FIT' family? Start from NPact customer stories (FFTC, Broward College Foundation, Catholic Foundation of Greater Philadelphia), Oracle NetSuite nonprofit case studies, and 990 Part VII-B payments to Fusion Laboratories LLC / NPact
conclusion_affected: cf-ledger-families-2026.csv SF_NETSUITE row for SVCF ($9.58bn): the vendor case study shows DAF allocation, fee and rebalancing calculations run in NPact FIT layered on NetSuite, so NPact's footprint by assets is understated
